title: Named columns present
description: Each column the run names is in the table, in the unit the run names where the kept table declares a unit for it; an undeclared unit is not checked. A missing column fails once with no row; a column declared in another unit fails once with no row and its declared unit as the value.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.source: Named by the run: the columns, and their units, the team expects of the table (E192).

words.template: {count} named columns are missing or in another unit, the first is {first}.
